backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as a placeholder backend for the ICP application.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including design specification, hero section, unveiling sequence, focus spotlight, wave section, product details, editions showcase, and footer with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files describing their purpose and functionality in the KAYSEN Botanical Luxury stop-motion aesthetic application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color palettes using OKLCH color space for the KAYSEN luxury brand aesthetic.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the KAYSEN Botanical Luxury application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component orchestrating the single-page scroll experience by rendering all section components (Hero, UnveilingSequence, FocusSpotlight, WaveSection, ProductDetails, EditionsShowcase, Footer) in sequence.
frontend/src/components/EditionsShowcase: Editions showcase component displaying three KAYSEN product variants (Emerald, Botanical, Luxury) with scroll-triggered animations, interactive selection highlighting, and luxury presentation styling.
frontend/src/components/FocusSpotlight.t: Focus section featuring animated spotlight with ratcheted mechanical movements that targets product details (Botanical Essence, Luxury Cap, Crystal Clarity) with stepped transitions and synchronized audio feedback.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with KAYSEN branding, informational sections (About, Experience, Connect), social media links, copyright notice, and required caffeine.ai attribution with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section component with parallax diorama layers, stop-motion entrance animation, and brand title display using scroll-based transformations.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetails.t: Product details section displaying KAYSEN bottle image, ingredients list, and product story with staggered scroll-based reveal animations.
frontend/src/components/UnveilingSequenc: Mechanical unveiling animation with articulated SVG hands that reveal a bottle using ratcheted scroll progress and sound effects.
frontend/src/components/WaveSection.tsx: Water feature section with spring physics-based wave animations, floating botanical elements, and ripple effects triggered by scroll.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages backend actor instances based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity persistence, and authentication status.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollAnimation.ts: Custom hook that tracks element scroll progress and viewport visibility using IntersectionObserver and scroll event listeners.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpringPhysics.ts: React hook implementing spring physics animation with configurable stiffness and damping, using requestAnimationFrame to animate values toward a target with velocity-based motion.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color palette for emerald/botanical luxury theme, including dark mode variants, custom font families (Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, Inter), and utility classes for brand colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/utils/animations.ts: Animation utility functions providing stop-motion timing with stepped motion (8 steps), ratchet timing (6 steps), easing functions, spring physics configs, and scroll trigger thresholds.
frontend/src/utils/audioManager.ts: Web Audio API manager that generates synthetic mechanical sounds (ratchet clicks, mechanical whirs, spring bounces) using oscillators and gain nodes for stop-motion aesthetic audio feedback.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending default theme with OKLCH color system for KAYSEN brand (emerald, botanical, luxury gold colors), custom fonts (Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond), container settings, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining KAYSEN Botanical Luxury webapp with stop-motion aesthetic, diorama stage presentation, mechanical animations, required product images, and completed features including hero, unveiling, focus, and wave sections.
